page.overview:
Who is Fridwulfa?

Fridwulfa was a giantess, the ex-wife of Mr Hagrid, and the mother of Rubeus Hagrid the half-giant and Grawp the giant.

In 1928, Fridwulfa bore a child with Mr Hagrid, but deserted him and her son, Rubeus, when he was three years old. She returned to the giants, and bore another child, Grawp, by another giant. She died years before the events of the Second Wizarding War.

The reason she deserted three-year-old Rubeus was that he was "small" in size, and giants prefer to produce large-sized children. The same disappointment went to her second son, Grawp. For her desertion, Mr Hagrid was heartbroken and Rubeus didn't remember her much except for not being a great mother.
